decisions.reason: Because it stayed on the website into 2024 and is close to the core upholstery offer, management is likely to keep it, but the shift from a dedicated page to a mere mention suggests results may be only borderline relative to aspiration levels.
Its continued website presence and close fit with the firm's decorative textiles range make it likely satisfactory enough to retain, especially in a growing industry with some innovation slack.
A dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024 indicates strong attention and likely performance at or above aspirations, reinforced by its functional flame-retardant feature for contract customers.
As a product building on the established decorative range and still shown in 2024, it is more likely to be kept, though its lower prominence suggests only moderate confidence in its payoff.

The product remains on the site and extends the firm's established offer, so boundedly rational management would usually continue it unless performance clearly fell short, though its niche character raises some risk.

Being newly launched in 2024 and given its own page, it is likely still in the evaluation window, and a medium-sized innovative textile firm with a broad range would usually allow more time before dropping it.
